Chapter 278: Chapter 19: Ascension Platform (Please Subscribe)_2

Li Qing paused for a moment, then whispered, “No disciple has yet cultivated to the Sixth Stage Martial Tao…”

“Indeed.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path had only been spreading for a little more than two hundred years, yet it had already cultivated so many practitioners, which could be considered rapid development.

In fact, the fastest development of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path occurred in the last hundred years.

A hundred years ago, Lin Yuan, with an absolutely overwhelming manner, approached the gates of Daode Immortal Sect. Even though he ultimately did not breach Mount Morality Immortal, who didn’t know of his invincible might?

...

Hence, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path propagated by Lin Yuan naturally attracted countless people, especially the heterodox and Left Paths from the Eastern Sea Islands, who were particularly eager to join White Jade Pavilion.

“Sixth Stage Martial Tao…”

Even with Lin Yuan’s guidance, White Jade Pavilion has yet to produce a Sixth Stage Martial Tao practitioner.

Lin Yuan was not surprised by this fact.

The Sixth Rank corresponded to the Ancient Saint of Refinement Void; even in the Main World, the leap from the Fifth to Sixth Rank was a threshold.

The essence of life for Sixth-Rank Evolvers transformed, enabling them to imprint their life seals onto the Cosmic Starry Skies.

In this world, the Ancient Saint of Refinement Void was undoubtedly the ceiling of combat power. Even a strong force like Daode Immortal Sect was mostly guarded by a single Ancient Saint.

Actually, had it not been for Lin Yuan’s Sudden Enlightenment in the Main World, breaking the limitations of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path to make it inclusive of everything,

otherwise, now not to mention Sixth Stage Martial Tao, probably there would only be a few at the Fourth or Fifth Stages.

Not everyone possesses talent in the domain of Taiyin Taiyang Taiji.

“Next, I need to take a trip away.”

After chatting with his family and disciples for a while, Lin Yuan spoke up.

“Leaving?”

Mu Lian’er had a guess in her heart and tentatively asked, “Wuji, are you thinking of going to Mount Morality Immortal?”

A hundred years ago, Lin Yuan did not force his way into Mount Morality Immortal.

A hundred years later, after several breakthroughs, the purpose of Lin Yuan leaving Baiyu Island is self-evident.

“Right.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Mount Morality Immortal was indeed one of his goals.

“Wuji…”

Mu Lian’er sighed, wanting to say more but hesitating.

“Mother, rest assured, I have a sense of measure in what I do,” Lin Yuan comforted.

His trip to Daode Immortal Sect was indeed with the intent of ‘negotiating.’

Of course, those eligible to negotiate with Lin Yuan could only be the Ancestral Masters of the Spirit Realm from Daode Immortal Sect.

…

Outside Baiyu Island.

The figure of Lin Yuan appeared.

“Daode Immortal Sect…”

Lin Yuan glanced in the direction of the Central Divine Continent.

Before heading to Daode Immortal Sect, Lin Yuan had another matter to attend to.

That was the deep sea beneath the very Baiyu Island.

More precisely, it was the deep sea bottom underneath Baiyu Island.

The position of Baiyu Island was not fixed; it would sink to the bottom of the deep sea every two thousand years, and then resurface after another two thousand years.

Now, Baiyu Island had already become the holy land for Martial Dao Cultivators.

Even in the future, when the focal point of the Martial Arts System might shift to Central Divine Continent, the position of Baiyu Island would still be irreplaceable.

Just as in the Main World, it is the same as the Ancestral Star, the mother star of the Human Civilization Alliance.

The territory of the Human Civilization Alliance is vast, encompassing countless Life Planets, but there is only one Ancestral Star, the mother star.

Its symbolic significance exceeds all else.

In this scenario, if Baiyu Island were to continue to follow the two-thousand-year pattern of sinking and floating, it would naturally be somewhat inappropriate.

…

The bottom of the deep sea.

It was almost completely dark here.

Terrible pressure from the sea bore down from all directions.

Even Nascent Soul Stage, Divinity Transformation Stage cultivators didn’t dare to stay in such an environment for long periods of time.

What’s more…

In the bottom of the deep sea, the most terrifying thing is not the extreme environment.

But rather those ancient and ferocious Demonic Beasts that have existed for tens of thousands of years.

“Hm?”

Following below Baiyu Island, Lin Yuan came to the bottom of the deep sea.

“This place is a Deep Sea Eye. Every two thousand years, as sea water circulates, a tremendous suction force emerges, devouring vast amounts of sea water and conveying it to the other side of the East Sea, in an endless cycle, once every two thousand years…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

And Baiyu Island was right above the eye of the sea; whenever a suction force emerged, the island would uncontrollably sink until it reached the bottom of the deep sea and blocked the eye of the sea, only then stopping.

Once the suction force disappeared, Baiyu Island naturally floated back up.

“To resist this suction force isn’t difficult, one just needs to seal this eye of the sea,” he said. “Not to mention an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void, even a Mahayana Phase Heaven Lord could do it.”

“Only…”

Lin Yuan glanced around.

With his perception, he naturally noticed that many deep sea behemoths with terrifying auras were nearby.

Should he start sealing the eye of the sea, he would definitely alarm those deep sea behemoths. With their enormous bodies and the fact they were in their home territory…

Even an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void, if surrounded by a group of deep sea behemoths, would probably only be able to flee in a sorry state.

But for Lin Yuan, of course, this wasn’t an issue.

“Seal.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the eye of the deep sea, his mind slightly stirring, releasing strands of essence that began to seal the massive eye of the sea.

Hum.

Far away, many deep sea behemoths noticed the disturbance.

They immediately started to approach.

The next moment.

These deep sea behemoths seemed to realize something.

They fled at speeds tens of times faster than when they had approached.

“Quite astute,” he said.

Lin Yuan glanced at those deep sea behemoths frantically fleeing; he had intentionally let out a small trace of his aura, which nearly scared the behemoths out of their wits.

While the behemoths of the deep sea had low spiritual wisdom, they weren’t stupid. Feeling an aura far surpassing their own, who would dare to approach?

…

An hour later.

Lin Yuan completely sealed the eye of the deep sea.

He then left the seabed and headed in the direction of the Central Divine Continent.

Mount Morality Immortal.

Lin Yuan’s form appeared without a sound.

A hundred years had passed, yet Mount Morality Immortal had not changed.

But the disciples of the sect had obviously become much more low-key. If they had no important business, they almost never left Mount Morality Immortal.

“You two stay outside,” he said.

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, his mind slightly moving, and Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit emerged, standing on each side of him.

Although with Lin Yuan’s current strength, even if the Daode Immortal Sect really did summon the Ancestral Masters of the Spirit Realm,

It would likely be useless, posing no threat to Lin Yuan.

But it’s always best to be cautious, just in case.

For safety, Lin Yuan decided to keep Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit outside.

Lin Yuan’s original self and Yin Spirit and Yang Spirit were a united three; as long as one still existed, the other two could be reborn, even if they were annihilated or fallen.

Taiyin giving rise to Taiyang.

Or Taiyang giving rise to Taiyin.

Finally, Taiji giving birth to all things, where ‘all things’ refer to Lin Yuan’s physical body.

“Leave a drop of essence blood outside,” he said.

Lin Yuan raised his right hand; a drop of crimson essence blood emerged, falling into the Yang Spirit.

Though Taiyin and Taiyang blended into Taiji, which in turn fostered the physical body, this method would take a considerable amount of time.

And it would also consume some origin source.

If he used essence blood instead, it would be much better.

The Physical Body Divine Ability that Lin Yuan mastered—Blood Rebirth.

Even with only a drop of fresh blood, he could quickly be reborn; such was the power of divine skills.

“Now it’s about time,” he said.

Lin Yuan looked at the preparations he made, a smile appearing on his face.

With these precautions, even if the most unlikely situation occurred, he could recover as quickly as possible.

“Daode Immortal Sect…”

Lin Yuan turned his head, looking toward the immortal mountain not far off.

The many Sect Protection Arrays passed through Lin Yuan’s eyes.

If it had been a hundred years earlier, Lin Yuan would have had to forcefully break through these Sect Protection Arrays.

But after a hundred years, besides cultivating, he also refined his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, completely grasping all the Sect Protection Arrays of the Daode Immortal Sect.

A hundred years ago, the combined strike of Lin Yuan’s original Yang God and Yin God self was even aimed at observing the operation of the formation.

Under the immense pressure caused by Lin Yuan’s intervention, the Daode Immortal Sect’s many Sect Protection Arrays operated beyond their capacity, allowing Lin Yuan to witness some of their essence.

Through Against-Heaven’s Understanding of these formation essences, Lin Yuan now could definitely be called the top Formation master in the Central Divine Continent.

Especially regarding the many Sect Protection Arrays of the Daode Immortal Sect, he knew them like the back of his hand and could easily come and go as he pleased.
